purpose: silver_nyc_flights cleans the bronze Airbyte landing of the 2013 NYC-origin flights dataset into one row per scheduled flight leg, with pipeline metadata removed and numeric fields cast to their natural integer and timestamp types, for downstream analytics on departure and arrival delays, routes, and carriers.
usage: Join or group on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin, dest) to treat each row as a distinct flight leg; dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time are nullable (~3% null) and consumers must decide deliberately whether to filter these out or treat them as cancelled/diverted flights before computing delay aggregates; time_hour is a TIMESTAMP suitable for time-series joins.
limitations: Cleanup dropped all three Airbyte metadata columns and performed no deduplication since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0; nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay (null_rate ~0.03), air_time (0.032981), and tailnum (0.009154) were retained rather than resolved, and the declared grain's uniqueness beyond the zero observed duplicate rate has not been independently verified against the full warehouse.
